name: redis-shared-memory-editor
description: Capture private prompts, propose confirmed lifecycle updates, and use shared Redis Agent Memory and Playbook.

interface.shortDescription: Capture privately, promote with consent, and prepare governed agendas.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP integration for multiple users and their agents to capture prompts and session-end markers in private Redis Agent Memory namespaces, propose reviewable lifecycle updates against exact current state, promote them only with explicit confirmation, read reconciled management state, and prepare Playbook-governed reviews with confirmed decisions, progress, open work, and a two-pass conflict-aware topic draft. Each user keeps service credentials and participant attribution in a private local file.
defaultPrompt: Check the Redis Shared Memory connection status.
Find the current source-grounded management state for this project.
Prepare a cited management review agenda for the next meeting.
